title: Phosphorylation of cytochrome c at tyrosine 48 finely regulates its binding to the histone chaperone SET/TAF-Ibeta in the nucleus.
authors: Tamargo-Azpilicueta, Joaquin; Casado-Combreras, Miguel A; Giner-Arroyo, Rafael L; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian; Marquez, Inmaculada; Olloqui-Sariego, Jose L; De la Rosa, Miguel A; Diaz-Moreno, Irene
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与生物物理实验，研究细胞色素c Tyr48磷酸化对其与组蛋白伴侣SET/TAF-Ibeta核内结合及活性的调控，属广义蛋白-DNA互作（组蛋白伴侣）且含MD方法，但非TF-DNA体系，可借鉴其磷酸化调控互作建模思路。
abstract: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) of proteins are ubiquitous processes present in all life kingdoms, involved in the regulation of protein stability, subcellular location and activity. In this context, cytochrome c (Cc) is an excellent case study to analyze the structural and functional changes induced by PTMS as Cc is a small, moonlighting protein playing different roles in different cell compartments at different cell-cycle stages. Cc is actually a key component of the mitochondrial electron transport chain (ETC) under homeostatic conditions but is translocated to the cytoplasm and even the nucleus under apoptotic conditions and/or DNA damage. Phosphorylation does specifically alter the Cc redox activity in the mitochondria and the Cc non-redox interaction with apoptosis-related targets in the cytoplasm. However, little is known on how phosphorylation alters the interaction of Cc with histone chaperones in the nucleus. Here, we report the effect of Cc Tyr48 phosphorylation by examining the protein interaction with SET/TAF-Ibeta in the nuclear compartment using a combination of molecular dynamics simulations, biophysical and structural approaches such as isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and in cell proximity ligation assays. From these experiments, we infer that Tyr48 phosphorylation allows a fine-tuning of the Cc-mediated inhibition of SET/TAF-Ibeta histone chaperone activity in vitro. Our findings likewise reveal that phosphorylation impacts the nuclear, stress-responsive functions of Cc, and provide an experimental framework to explore novel aspects of Cc post-translational regulation in the nucleus.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质的翻译后修饰（PTMs）是存在于所有生命界中的普遍过程，参与调控蛋白质稳定性、亚细胞定位及活性。在此背景下，细胞色素c（Cc）是分析PTMs诱导的结构和功能变化的极佳案例，因为Cc是一种小型、具有多重功能的蛋白质，在不同细胞区室及不同细胞周期阶段发挥不同作用。在稳态条件下，Cc实际上是线粒体电子传递链（ETC）的关键组分，但在凋亡条件和/或DNA损伤时，它被转位至细胞质甚至细胞核。磷酸化确实特异性地改变线粒体中Cc的氧化还原活性，以及细胞质中Cc与凋亡相关靶标的非氧化还原相互作用。然而，关于磷酸化如何改变Cc在细胞核中与组蛋白伴侣相互作用的机制知之甚少。在此，我们通过结合分子动力学模拟、生物物理和结构方法（如等温滴定量热法（ITC）和核磁共振（NMR））以及细胞内邻近连接实验，研究了Cc Tyr48磷酸化对核区室中与SET/TAF-Ibeta蛋白相互作用的影响。从这些实验中，我们推断Tyr48磷酸化能够精细调节Cc介导的SET/TAF-Ibeta组蛋白伴侣活性的体外抑制。我们的发现同样揭示磷酸化影响Cc的核内应激响应功能，并为探索Cc在细胞核中翻译后调控的新方面提供了实验框架。
